method: Unauthenticated first-party documentation and marketing reads. Findings are summarized; full source pages are not copied into the repository.

sources.title: Welcome
sources.finding: Threads accept web, Slack, Linear and API prompts and carry hosted PR work.

sources.title: Quickstart
sources.locator: Signup; first thread; review and merge
sources.finding: GitHub App and project setup, live todos and diffs, PR creation and event-driven CI/review follow-up.

sources.title: Threads
sources.locator: Sending messages; statuses; todos; folders; search
sources.finding: Persistent conversations, steer/interrupt/queue, attention buckets, editable resting status, folders, tags and full-text search.

sources.title: Subagents
sources.locator: Isolation; parallel vs stacked; lifecycle; results; models; sibling threads
sources.finding: Agent-created editable drafts, three child levels, shared read-only or fresh writer machines, sequential stacks, result messages and per-child models.

sources.title: Projects
sources.finding: Multi-repository projects with base branches, stable thread codes, GitHub-scoped clones and repoless projects.

sources.title: Machines
sources.finding: Managed Ubuntu VMs; filesystem survives sleep but processes do not; deletion after 30 idle days; cross-machine file transfer.

sources.title: Environment
sources.finding: Versioned per-repository setup scripts and services, repository setup file, snapshot restore and fallback boot, explicit command launch.

sources.title: Instructions
sources.finding: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md fallback, nested and glob rules, organization/personal instructions; next-thread update semantics.

sources.title: Skills
sources.finding: Built-in, repository and Drive skills load on demand; portable SKILL.md workflow files.

sources.title: Drive
sources.locator: Scopes; saved files; history; storage limits
sources.finding: Shared and personal persisted files outside Git, browser editing, version history and restore; older versions kept for 24 hours.

sources.title: Automations
sources.finding: Stored prompts run on cron, GitHub/Slack events and webhooks; explicit principals, daily caps, idempotency and new or standing threads.

sources.title: Pull requests
sources.finding: Branch creation at publish, commit/push/PR tool, CI failures and human comments wake threads; stacked PR bases and last-push ownership.

sources.title: Reviews
sources.finding: Dedicated reviewer checks exact PR head, posts inline GitHub findings, reruns on pushes, carries open findings and respects triage.

sources.title: Models and pricing
sources.locator: Plans; no seats; connections; machine pricing
sources.finding: Lite $20, Pro $100, Max $200 to $1,000 monthly; annual 20% discount; unlimited members; provider connections and hourly compute.

sources.title: Members
sources.finding: Owner/admin/member roles, membership changes, no seat charge and explicit service identities.

sources.title: Billing
sources.finding: Per-thread costs, member/model spend, tokens and bounded auto-reloads; subscriptions need no plan, keys/gateways require Lite or higher.

sources.title: Security
sources.locator: Isolation; proxy; secrets; merge; data handling
sources.finding: Cloud credential proxy and scoped encrypted secrets; explicit merge request rule; encrypted backend history and machine retention.

sources.title: Slack
sources.finding: Mention starts a synced thread; files, channel mapping, stop and muted conversation controls; multiple people can reply.

sources.title: Linear
sources.finding: Native Linear agent sessions map to Capy threads, stream plans/progress, preserve identifiers and explicit user links.

sources.title: MCP
sources.finding: Org/project HTTP and local stdio MCP tools with shared/personal credentials; dedicated review agent never receives MCP tools.

sources.title: API reference
sources.finding: Bearer keys act as explicit principals; threads, messages, streams, automations, read-only subagents, reviews and usage.

sources.title: Get usage report
sources.finding: Windowed organization model/image/VM spend and token totals with member/model breakdowns; no per-child field established.

sources.title: Download Capy
sources.locator: Platforms; local vs cloud; session import
sources.finding: macOS, Windows and Linux clients; local-folder execution and cross-device access while the paired computer stays online; optional Codex/Claude Code session import.

sources.title: Capy pricing
sources.finding: Current plans list unlimited members, Lite $20 monthly, Pro $100, Max $200+ and Enterprise custom; paid $1 seven-day Lite introduction.

sources.title: Security at Capy
sources.finding: Vendor states SOC 2 Type II with report in Trust Center; provider terms govern provider processing; enterprise SSO and audit/export options by agreement.

sources.title: Capy 0.4.6
sources.finding: Released private thread/project sharing, specific-person access, transfer ownership and admin sharing defaults.

sources.title: Capy changelog
sources.finding: Release feed includes 0.4.6 dated 9 October 2026; roadmap commitments remain separate from released capabilities.

sources.title: About Capy
sources.finding: About page identifies Scrapybara, Inc. in San Francisco, while the website footer and retained profile name Capy Corporation; legal identity not resolved.

sources.title: Open source program
sources.finding: This page describes a program for open-source maintainers, not an application source repository or license.
